I can see why many actors are into this idea of how movies are weaker than they used to be. They're talking about themselves. You know? Movies are getting astronomically more skilled at making impossible realities, come true. Johnson is not a spring chicken, but he pulls a LOT of weight as a fantasy, comic book hero, on screen. And THAT will give an actor confidence. Brosnan and Hodge were really packing it, in 'Black Adam.' Everything I heard, about 'BA' made me predict a horrible movie, and really happy I was 100 percent off the mark. THIS is an awesome movie. Johnson and Cavill no longer planning any more movies is too bad. But. You can go really far with a dude like Hodge. He's basically a foundation to build on, if DC wants a quick way to their version of Marvel's 'End Game.' Whoever came up with this 'version' of Hawkman is WAY beyond me. Like light years beyond me. And I'm really into comic book worlds. Great job.
